description: This Java source file defines the class ClientConfigProperties, which extends AbstractConfig and encapsulates various configuration properties needed for establishing and managing AMQP 1.0 client connections in the Eclipse Hono framework. The class includes default values, getters, setters, and loading mechanisms for credentials.

classes.name: ClientConfigProperties
classes.description: Encapsulates configuration properties for an AMQP 1.0 client connection, including timeouts, credentials, connection parameters, and behavior settings.

methods.name: ClientConfigProperties
methods.description: Default constructor initializing properties with default values.

methods.name: ClientConfigProperties
methods.description: Copy constructor to create a new instance based on existing properties.

methods.name: getHost
methods.description: Returns the hostname or IP address of the target host for the client connection.

methods.name: setHost
methods.description: Sets the hostname or IP address of the target host.

methods.name: getPort
methods.description: Returns the TCP port number for the connection.

methods.name: setPort
methods.description: Sets the TCP port number for the connection, validates the port range.

methods.name: getUsername
methods.description: Returns the username for authentication, loading from credentials file if necessary.

methods.name: setUsername
methods.description: Sets the username for authentication.

methods.name: getPassword
methods.description: Returns the password for authentication as a String, loading from credentials file if necessary.

methods.name: setPassword
methods.description: Sets the password for authentication.

methods.name: getCredentialsPath
methods.description: Returns the file path to the credentials properties file.

methods.name: setCredentialsPath
methods.description: Sets the file path to the credentials properties file.

methods.name: loadCredentials
methods.description: Loads username and password from the credentials file if not already set.

methods.name: getName
methods.description: Returns the container ID name reported in the AMQP Open frame.

methods.name: setName
methods.description: Sets the container ID name in the AMQP Open frame.

methods.name: getAmqpHostname
methods.description: Returns the AMQP hostname reported in the Open frame.

methods.name: setAmqpHostname
methods.description: Sets the AMQP hostname in the Open frame.

methods.name: getFlowLatency
methods.description: Returns the maximum time to wait for credits after link creation.

methods.name: setFlowLatency
methods.description: Sets the maximum wait time for flow credits, must be non-negative.

methods.name: getLinkEstablishmentTimeout
methods.description: Returns the timeout for establishing a link with the peer.

methods.name: setLinkEstablishmentTimeout
methods.description: Sets the timeout for link establishment, must be non-negative.

methods.name: getInitialCredits
methods.description: Returns the initial credits allocated on link creation.

methods.name: setInitialCredits
methods.description: Sets the initial credits on link creation, must be non-negative.

methods.name: getSendMessageTimeout
methods.description: Returns the timeout for waiting for delivery update after sending message.

methods.name: setSendMessageTimeout
methods.description: Sets the send message timeout, must be non-negative.

methods.name: getRequestTimeout
methods.description: Returns the timeout for waiting for a response to a request.

methods.name: setRequestTimeout
methods.description: Sets the request timeout, must be non-negative.

methods.name: isHostnameVerificationRequired
methods.description: Indicates if hostname verification against server's certificate is required.

methods.name: setHostnameVerificationRequired
methods.description: Enables or disables hostname verification.

methods.name: isTlsEnabled
methods.description: Returns whether TLS encryption and verification are enabled.

methods.name: setTlsEnabled
methods.description: Enables or disables TLS for the connection.

methods.name: getReconnectAttempts
methods.description: Returns the number of reattempts for connection establishment.

methods.name: setReconnectAttempts
methods.description: Sets the number of reattempts for establishing connection, -1 for infinite.

methods.name: getReconnectMinDelay
methods.description: Returns the minimum delay before re-establishing connection.

methods.name: setReconnectMinDelay
methods.description: Sets the minimum delay before reconnection attempt, must be non-negative.

methods.name: getReconnectMaxDelay
methods.description: Returns the maximum delay before re-establishing connection.

methods.name: setReconnectMaxDelay
methods.description: Sets the maximum delay for reconnection, must be non-negative.

methods.name: getReconnectDelayIncrement
methods.description: Returns the exponential backoff increment for reconnection delay.

methods.name: setReconnectDelayIncrement
methods.description: Sets the exponential backoff increment, must be non-negative.

methods.name: getConnectTimeout
methods.description: Returns the timeout for initial connection establishment.

methods.name: setConnectTimeout
methods.description: Sets the connection timeout, must be non-negative.

methods.name: getHeartbeatInterval
methods.description: Returns the heartbeat interval, typically half of the idle timeout.

methods.name: getIdleTimeout
methods.description: Returns the idle timeout after which connection is closed.

methods.name: setIdleTimeout
methods.description: Sets the idle timeout, must be non-negative.
